# Mark Trageser

Mark Trageser is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2000 to 2006. He is known to have been one of the designers behind the Formula Fuelers series, as well as having worked on the Speed Readerz series. He is currently working for JMP Creative as a designer and 3D printing specialist and the founder of two Los Angeles-based toy companies; InsaniTOY and Kram-Co 3D.
